2025-2026

Provider: Fondazione per le Facoltà di Lugano dell’Università della Svizzera italiana

Submission deadline: 31 July 2025

Number of scholarships: 40

The Foundation for the Lugano Faculties of the Università della Svizzera italiana awards 40 scholarships of CHF 4'000 each to students enrolled in the first year of a Bachelor’s programme offered by the Faculty of Communication, Culture and Society, Faculty of Economics or Faculty of Informatics who at the time of obtaining their university entrance qualification (high school diploma or equivalent) had legal residence in the German- or French-speaking part of Switzerland (Canton of the Grisons included). Applications must be submitted through the appropriate online form. Its link will be provided with the letter of admission to the Bachelor’s programme.

• Bachelor in Comunicazione
  • Bachelor in Data Science
  • Bachelor in Informatics
  • Bachelor in Lingua, letteratura e civiltà italiana
  • Bachelor in Scienze economiche
  • Bachelor of Arts in Economics
